Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : The documents to be furnished by the Supplier shall be as follows:
1) Valid TIN Certificate (Up-to-date).
2) Valid VAT Registration Certificate.
3) Valid Trade License.
4) The Tenderer must have at least 05 (Five) years experience.
5) The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single tender of min Taka 20 Lac on electrical goods in last two (02)
years.
6) The bidder/tenderer should have the Bank solvency Certificate.
7) List of 5 organizations (Govt./ Non-Govt.) where similar projects (Computer, Electrical goods, Industrial On Line UPS, Stabilizer,
Battery) done by the company mentioning with client name, duration of project completion, total manpower involvement (enclose
work order/contract agreement).
8) The original money receipt/challan issued by the authority as an evidence of purchase the Tender Documents by the Tenderer.
9) In order to proof the Tenderers Financial capability necessary to perform the contract the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover (at least 57 Lacs) over the last tree (03) years.
10) The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 20 Lac.
Brief Description of Goods and Related Ten desktop and laptops, one plotter, six printers, one digital camera, one photocopy machine, one scanner, two multimedia
